text:
Type: blackout curtain panels with tiebacks, set of two
Use: blocking light, privacy; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: smooth woven polyester, rod pocket top, matching tiebacks
Colors: dark charcoal grey
Shape: plain panels, gathered rod pocket header, soft vertical folds, solid matte fabric, short sill to below-sill length
Feel: moody, calm, cozy
Goes with: white or light grey walls, cognac leather, black rods, green plants; modern or industrial rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Room Darkening Blackout Window Curtains with Tie Backs Set, 52" x 63", Dark Grey
product.description: Blackout curtain blocks out sunlight and harmful UV rays, reduces outside noise, and ensures total privacy Creates energy-saving insulating barrier against heat and cold, keeping room cooler in the summer and warmer in the winter 2 panels made of innovative triple-weave fabric; no stiff liner; elegantly frames windows with a sophisticated drape Rod pocket fits any standard or decorative rod; includes 2 Velcro ties for pulling back the curtains Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards. The color may appear slightly different from photographs depending on the lighting where the curtains are hung
